reason: The original harness marked the run passed from wall-clock duration, but the final observation preceded process completion by 7,119 seconds. Only 83,587 seconds of continuous samples were collected, so this is not accepted as a 24-hour observation.
remediation: The harness now rejects any observation gap over 30 seconds, including the terminal interval.
scope: Sanitized post-run validation of the ten-device local simulator soak. No credentials, conversation content, raw logs, or database data are retained here.
